Create a High-Performance GPU Map Widget (glmap)

Source: R/map.R
glmap.Rd

Initializes a glmap WebGL2 + MapLibre GL interactive map widget. If data is supplied (sf, sfc, SpatRaster, SpatVector, wk::xy, nanoarrow, data.frame, or crosstalk::SharedData), glmap() automatically inspects its type and adds the appropriate GPU layer unless layers are added downstream via pipes (|>).

Usage

glmap(
  data = NULL,
  basemap = "dark",
  api_key = NULL,
  center = NULL,
  zoom = NULL,
  pitch = 0,
  bearing = 0,
  projection = c("mercator", "globe"),
  transport = c("auto", "inline", "server"),
  width = "100%",
  height = NULL,
  elementId = NULL,
  auto_layer = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

Optional default spatial dataset (sf, sfc, SpatRaster, data.frame, or SharedData).

basemap

Basemap style name ("dark", "positron", "voyager", "osm", "satellite", "none"), a provider from gl_providers, or a custom MapLibre style URL / {z}/{x}/{y} template.

api_key

Optional API key string for the basemap provider (can also be configured globally via gl_set_api_key() or environment variables such as CARTO_API_KEY, MAPTILER_API_KEY, STADIA_API_KEY).

center

Numeric vector c(lon, lat) for initial map center. Auto-computed from layers if NULL.

zoom

Numeric initial zoom level.

pitch

Numeric initial tilt angle in degrees (0 to 85).

bearing

Numeric initial rotation bearing in degrees.

projection

Map projection: "mercator" (default) or "globe".

transport

Binary transport mode: "auto" (inline gzipped binary up to 25 MB, works in static HTML & Viewer), "server" (streams via local httpuv binary range server), or "inline".

width

Widget width (CSS units).

height

Widget height (CSS units).

elementId

Optional HTML element ID.

auto_layer

Logical; if TRUE and data is provided, automatically adds a default GPU layer when the map is printed/rendered if no explicit add_*() layers were called.

...

Additional arguments passed to the default layer when auto_layer = TRUE.

Value

An htmlwidget object of class c("glmap", "glmap", "htmlwidget").
